## sub_5823C0_005823c0 — Struct array initialization with dual linked list setup

**Summary:** Allocates and initializes a 164-byte object containing 4 sub-structs (40 bytes each) via NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb with StructInitializationWithVTable and sub_57AEF0 callbacks. Wraps the object into a 12-byte node and appends to list1 (this+0x0). Pre-allocates 4 nodes into list2 (this+0x10), one per sub-struct slot, with free-flag=0. Returns final count.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** NetworkPacketQueueReader (005805c0)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x0 | RW | — | List1 head pointer; updated when first node appended |
| this | 0x4 | RW | — | List1 tail pointer; updated when node appended |
| this | 0x8 | RW | — | List1 cursor/iterator; updated when first node added |
| this | 0xC | RW | — | List1 element count; incremented on node append |
| this | 0x10 | RW | — | List2 head pointer; updated when first node pre-allocated |
| this | 0x14 | RW | — | List2 tail pointer; updated during node pre-allocation |
| this | 0x18 | RW | — | List2 cursor/iterator; updated during node pre-allocation |
| this | 0x1C | RW | — | List2 element count; incremented on each pre-allocated node |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x0: Set once on first append, persists as list1 head.
- this 0x4: Updated on append, persists as list1 tail.
- this 0x8: Set on first append, persists as list1 cursor.
- this 0xC: Incremented per append, persists as list1 count.
- this 0x10: Set once on first pre-alloc, persists as list2 head.
- this 0x14: Updated on each pre-alloc, persists as list2 tail.
- this 0x18: Set on first pre-alloc, persists as list2 cursor.
- this 0x1C: Incremented per pre-alloc, persists as list2 count.

**Functions called:**

| 00587c03 | OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper | Allocate 4-byte wrapper, 164-byte master object, and 12-byte node wrappers |
| 0058a6eb | NTimeCallbackLoopWithSEH_a6eb | Initialize 4 sub-struct slots (40 bytes each) in the master object |

**Guard conditions:** Allocation checks for wrapper (4 bytes) and master object (164 bytes) — if either fails, wrapper/v4 is null and list operations are skipped. Inner loop skips null slot pointers. Node allocation failures are handled silently (node set to 0).
